mode.survival.description: Lower amount = Higher chance to be eliminated
mode.crown-defense-half-test.name: Crown Defense: Half Damage
mode.crown-defense-half-test.description: A lot's HP = its amount; damage to all but the chosen lot = half the chosen lot's HP (rounded up to 0.01)
mode.weakest-link.name: The Weakest Link
mode.weakest-link.description: Equal chances for all; HP normalized to 1–100; only the rolled lot takes damage — equal to the mean HP of lots no stronger than it (or its own HP if it is the weakest)
mode.king-of-the-hill-amount.name: King of the Hill: HP = Amount
mode.king-of-the-hill-amount.description: A lot's HP = its amount with no normalization (rounded up to a whole number); the king is the highest-HP lot; a rolled challenger damages the king by its own HP, a rolled king destroys the weakest lot and absorbs its HP; a tie at the top goes by priority: current king, then attacker, then random
